Tom — thanks for the clear asks. Below is a concise plan we can fold directly into the MAP; I attached a worksheet with workload slices and a one-page timeline. High-level proposal: 

Workload definition (pilot):
- Prompt classes: "triage-summarize" (~8-24 tokens in, 32-128 tokens out), "slot-fill" (~6-12 in, 8-24 out), and "follow-up short" (~4-8 in, 12-32 out).
- Token distribution: 55% summarize, 30% slot-fill, 15% follow-up. Avg roundtrip tokens ~85.
- Conversation characteristics: median context window 512 tokens, 10% of requests include a 4k-context historical snippet.
- Warmup: 5-minute ramp with 100 synthetic warmup requests per worker to populate KV cache.

Success criteria / SLOs (POC acceptance):
- TTFT (time-to-first-token) p95 <= 600 ms for summarize profiles (95th percentile across the quick run).
- End-to-end latency (full response) p95 <= 1.2 s for the summarize profile.
- Sustained throughput: >= 12 tokens/sec per GPU under steady-state summarize mix (measured over 10-min windows).
- Concurrency targets: validate up to 64 concurrent sessions (user sessions, not raw RPS) with graceful degradation.
- Error rate: request-level failure rate < 0.5% (includes timeouts and 5xx).

Planned test phases and artifacts: 
- Phase A (validation quick run): 2-hour focused run to validate TTFT and basic concurrency behavior.
- Phase B (soak + variety): 6–8 hour run exercising 4k-context snippets and mixed load.
- Data collected: per-token latency histograms, KV cache hit rates, GPU utilization, per-route p95/p99, and sample outputs for quality checks.

Deliverables we’ll attach to the MAP: pilot-workload-slices-v1.xlsx (workload breakdown), map-timeline-v1.pdf (run schedule + responsibilities), and a short runbook with access/instrumentation steps.

Timing suggestion: quick run on Thu 20 May (PDT) with Phase B the following day if green. If that works, Marissa and I will provide the runbook and a DocuSign link for the MAP addendum.

Grace O'Connor

Thanks — adding a couple of engineering clarifications to fold into the runbook: 

- Model variants & fallback: we'll run the primary quantized 16-bit variant for the quick run. If we detect resource pressure, we’ll automatically route to a slightly smaller 8b-quant variant; we should capture both in acceptance criteria (p95 measured per-variant).
- Warmup sequences: include a 30s burst after instance spin-up and a 5-minute steady ramp (these are separate checks).
- Quality sampling: we'll snapshot 1% of responses for human QA to ensure quantization/regression risk is visible.
- Runbook note: please include a VPC egress window and the temporary service-account we should use for accessing CloudWatch + metrics; procurement can reserve it.

Small edit to success criteria suggestion: make TTFT p95 goal "<= 600 ms for summarize" a hard gate for Phase A; for Phase B we can relax to p95 <= 750 ms if cache-hit rate < 70%.

On availability — we can produce the final runbook and a short pre-run checklist by EOD Wed May 19.

- Marissa
